headline: Gajendra Singh joins 360 Bytes as head-HR & TA
summary: 360 Bytes has appointed Gajendra Singh as its head of human resources and talent acquisition to drive the company's people strategies and growth plans. Bringing over 27 years of industry experience, Singh will focus on building an agile talent acquisition framework, developing leadership capabilities, and scaling data-driven HR practices. He previously held senior HR leadership roles at organizations including Radical Minds Technologies and iSON Xperiences.

headline: Flock Safety reportedly offers employee buyouts amid workforce concerns
summary: Surveillance technology firm Flock Safety is offering voluntary employee buyouts to reduce its workforce without resorting to immediate layoffs. The move comes amid declining internal morale and growing public backlash over alleged misuses of its license plate recognition technology, which has led to contract cancellations across multiple cities and states. The company, which employs around 1,500 people, has not yet publicly disclosed the scale of the potential workforce reduction.

headline: Employee automates 15-hour task to under a minute, ends up with more work and 50-hour weeks
summary: After an employee automated a 15-hour weekly reporting task down to under a minute, their manager established the new efficiency as the baseline and assigned them additional duties, pushing their workweek to 50 hours without extra pay. The viral story highlights a growing corporate challenge regarding how organizations handle productivity gains created by automation. Experts note that without adjustments to compensation and job design, individual efficiency improvements risk resulting in heavier workloads rather than recognition.

headline: Nitin Soni takes charge as head-HR, Greater India operations, EssilorLuxottica
summary: EssilorLuxottica has appointed Nitin Soni as the Head of HR for its Greater India operations, based in Bengaluru. Soni brings over two decades of manufacturing HR and employee relations experience, having previously held key leadership roles at organizations including Reckitt, Sun Pharma, and BD.

headline: For a health insurer, employee wellbeing is harder to ignore than most
summary: Health insurer ManipalCigna is expanding its employee wellbeing strategy to align its internal workplace culture with the health products it sells. The company's framework addresses preventive care, mental health support, and life-stage demands to help reduce employee cognitive overload. By combining formal benefits with manager development and community initiatives, ManipalCigna aims to normalize support-seeking and foster a cohesive workplace culture.

headline: Employee finally secures retirement benefits after 24 years
summary: A 73-year-old former employee of National Insurance Company Limited has secured his retirement benefits following a 24-year legal battle. Although removed from service in 2002 over alleged claim irregularities, he was cleared of related criminal charges in 2009. The Telangana High Court subsequently modified his penalty to compulsory retirement, ordering the insurer to release his pension and dues within six weeks.

headline: Women cross 50% workforce mark in four industries, but leadership gap persists
summary: While women now comprise over half the workforce in four Indian industries, their representation in senior leadership and C-suite roles remains disproportionately low. This gap highlights that increasing female hiring alone does not automatically create a pipeline for executive positions. To address the divide, organizations must focus on sponsorship, promotion pathways, and tracking female talent throughout the entire employee lifecycle.

headline: Tasmac employees to get Rs 20,000 festival advance, Rs 6,000 annual uniform allowance
summary: The Tamil Nadu State Marketing Corporation (Tasmac) has sanctioned an interest-free festival advance of Rs 20,000 and an annual uniform allowance of Rs 6,000 for its retail employees. The festival advance will be recovered through regular installments, while the uniform allowance covers three sets of work attire per year. Additionally, Tasmac is preparing to mandate digital payments for consumer purchases exceeding Rs 500.

headline: Bank of America appoints Sophie Dhariwala as SVP-HRBP, APAC
summary: Bank of America has appointed Sophie Dhariwala as Senior Vice President and HR Business Partner for the Asia-Pacific region, based in Singapore. In this role, she will lead end-to-end HR strategy, conduct, and risk oversight for the bank's Analyst and Associate populations. Dhariwala brings over 15 years of internal experience to the position, most recently serving as head of APAC lateral talent acquisition and internal mobility.

headline: Shemaroo Filmi Gaane marks 75M subscribers with 15-episode IP
summary: To celebrate reaching 75 million YouTube subscribers, Shemaroo Filmi Gaane has launched 'Celebrating 75 Music Legends,' a 15-episode digital series highlighting iconic Hindi film artists. The channel, which houses a catalog of over 10,000 songs, also released a promotional brand film to mark the milestone. Currently, the platform generates approximately 300 million monthly views for parent company Shemaroo Entertainment.
